interview.hardest_part: Navigating the opening fights with the Ascender's Bane curse which weakens all attacks, combined with high enemy stats on Ascension 10 requiring careful energy and defense play
interview.likely_failure: Dying early from poor card sequencing or not building key synergies before the first elite boss fight
interview.helpful_mechanics: Visible enemy intent allows precise timing for attacks and blocks; the branching map and reward system enable multiple paths to success
interview.harmful_mechanics: Curse limits early card power and deck building; small mistakes in combat can quickly lead to run failure on high difficulty
